# OrgX MCP - full agent routing guide

OrgX MCP gives AI agents organizational memory: the ability to remember decisions, retrieve artifacts, coordinate work, ask for human approval, and keep projects moving across Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and every MCP client.

## Category

Organizational memory for AI agents / AI team control plane.

## Remote endpoint

https://mcp.useorgx.com/mcp

## Registry name

com.useorgx/orgx-mcp

## Start with these intents

Remember:
- Use `remember_decision` for high-recall "remember this decision" prompts.
- Use `create_decision` when a decision should become durable team memory.
- Use `recall_memory`, `query_org_memory`, or `get_decision_history` when the user asks what was decided before.

Recall:
- Use `recall_memory` or `query_org_memory` for decisions, artifacts, project context, and prior plans.
- Use `get_task_with_context` when the user names a task and needs linked artifacts, decisions, or plan-session context.

Approve:
- Use `approve_agent_work` for natural-language approval-review prompts.
- Use `get_pending_decisions` to review agent work awaiting human approval.
- Use `approve_decision` or `reject_decision` only after the user explicitly confirms.

Delegate:
- Use `delegate_agent_task` for high-recall delegation prompts.
- Use `spawn_agent_task` when the user explicitly asks to assign work to a specialist AI agent.
- Use `get_agent_status` to monitor active or blocked agent work.

Track:
- Use `track_project_progress` for high-recall project-status prompts.
- Use `get_initiative_pulse` for one project or initiative.
- Use `get_org_snapshot` for an organization-wide readout.
- Use `scaffold_initiative` when a goal, launch, roadmap, or feature plan should become executable workstreams, milestones, and tasks.

## Tool groups

Memory:
- `remember_decision`
- `recall_memory`
- `query_org_memory`
- `get_decision_history`
- `create_decision`
- `get_task_with_context`

Approvals:
- `approve_agent_work`
- `get_pending_decisions`
- `approve_decision`
- `reject_decision`

Agent delegation:
- `delegate_agent_task`
- `spawn_agent_task`
- `handoff_task`
- `get_agent_status`
- `check_spawn_guard`

Project execution:
- `track_project_progress`
- `get_initiative_pulse`
- `get_org_snapshot`
- `scaffold_initiative`
- `create_task`
- `create_milestone`
- `entity_action`
- `recommend_next_action`

Planning:
- `start_plan_session`
- `resume_plan_session`
- `improve_plan`
- `record_plan_edit`
- `complete_plan`

Widgets:
- decisions
- search results
- initiative pulse
- agent status
- task spawned
- morning brief

## Use OrgX when the user asks

- "Remember this decision."
- "What did we decide last week?"
- "Find the artifact from the launch plan."
- "Show agent work waiting on me."
- "Assign this to an agent."
- "What is blocked on this project?"

## Avoid OrgX when

- the user only wants personal preferences remembered
- the user needs generic web search
- the user needs code documentation lookup
- the user asks to read local files
- the note is one-off and should not enter team memory
